author: ValWood
body:
Dear all, 

The proposal has been made to obsolete

GO:0018317 protein C-linked glycosylation via tryptophan 
GO:0018406 protein C-linked glycosylation via 2'-alpha-mannosyl-L-tryptophan 


see https://github.com/geneontology/go-ontology/issues/29770

Experimental annotations that need to be reviewed are here: 
https://github.com/geneontology/go-annotation/blob/master/reports/5804/GO_0018317-GO_0018406.tsv

1 annotation 

UniProt | WB:WBGene00001078 | dpy-19 | PMID:23562325\|WB_REF:WBPaper00042218 |   | GO:0018406 | protein C-linked glycosylation via 2'-alpha-mannosyl-L-tryptophan | IDA |   |   | PANTHER:PTHR31488 | 20130423 |   | NCBITaxon:6239

will be migrated to [GO:0018103](https://www.ebi.ac.uk/QuickGO/term/GO:0018103) protein C-linked glycosylation


----


GO:0018406 | interpro2go | InterPro:IPR047462 C-mannosyltransferase Dpy19 > GO:protein C-linked glycosylation via 2'-alpha-mannosyl-L-tryptophan ; GO:0018406

GO:0018406 | resid2go | RESID:AA0217 > GO:protein C-linked glycosylation via 2'-alpha-mannosyl-L-tryptophan ; GO:0018406

Thanks.
